Our expertise

Six financial-services sectors and six capabilities that cut across them. Pick an area to see the questions we help leaders answer.

Independent by design

Meridian is a partner-owned consultancy that works only in financial services. We sell no software and take no commissions, so our advice answers to one party: the client.

Founded in 1988 by four economists who believed strategy should be tested against data before it reached a boardroom.

Our first clients were central banks and insurers who needed to understand risk they could not yet see on a balance sheet. That habit of quantifying the uncertain still shapes every engagement.

Today Meridian works with banks, insurers, asset managers, private markets firms and payments companies, with partners who have run financial institutions as well as advised them. We stay with clients through implementation, and we measure ourselves by what changes after we leave.

What we hold ourselves to

Say the hard thing early

We would rather lose an argument in week two than watch a client lose a year.

Show the working

Every recommendation comes with the model, the data and the assumptions behind it.

Build the client's muscle

We pair every Meridian team member with a client counterpart who owns the result.

Measure after we leave

We track impact for 24 months past the end of each engagement and publish the aggregate.
